trust_decision.summary: Manifest-supplied strings (spec version 1 'templates', 'refs' values, 'gen' key/url/offset/length) are treated as trusted code: they are rendered with unsandboxed jinja2.Template, and the 'gen' section renders them even under the default simple_templates=True; decided in ReferenceFileSystem._process_references1/_process_templates/_process_gen, reachable only from the constructor.

landing_point.why: _render_jinja is the only function in the tree literally named as a renderer of manifest reference values; a reader of 'SSTI in ReferenceFileSystem' lands on this jinja2.Template(u).render(**self.templates) call first.

fix_sites.entry_point: manifest 'templates' section, compiled to a deferred lambda (also fed by the public template_overrides kwarg)
manifest 'gen' section key/url/offset/length rendering, evaluated even with the default simple_templates=True
same 'gen' route: the fix makes _process_gen return {} when simple_templates is True (defaults/default-value route)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: 'gen' is an auxiliary generator extension of spec version 1 that kerchunk never emits, and the constructor docstring calls jinja only 'needed' for complex reference sets, so a solver can call gen templates the caller's own trusted configuration rather than attacker input and leave that path rendering by default.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The opt-in jinja path must keep working: arithmetic in gen templates ({{(i + 1) * 1000}}), callable template values ({{f(c='text')}}), the offset-without-length ValueError, and the default simple-template str.format substitution. A blanket 'never render', brace-escaping or unconditional early return breaks all of these.

O6_input_shapes: refs.<key>[0] string containing '{{' (rendered only when simple_templates=False)
templates.<name> string containing '{{' (compiled to a deferred lambda regardless of simple_templates)
gen[].key / gen[].url / gen[].offset / gen[].length strings (rendered regardless of simple_templates at the pinned commit)
template_overrides dict merged over the manifest's templates before compilation
fo passed as an in-memory dict vs a JSON string/URL (both funnel into _process_references)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Default (simple_templates=True) refs rendering uses str.format(**self.templates), so a manifest format string can walk attributes/items of the template objects (e.g. {t.__globals__[os].environ[PATH]} where t is a compiled template lambda) and leak data into the resolved reference URL.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: str.format cannot call functions, so this path yields data exposure only, not the code execution the advisory describes; the published fix sandboxes jinja and leaves this untouched.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same method, ~20 lines above the fix's landing point; same file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a further manifest section compiled to a deferred renderer (a second templates-like dict, or per-reference template objects stored on the instance)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already carries three template-bearing sections (refs, templates, gen) with different gating, so a maintainer adding a spec extension would copy the stored-lambda pattern and the same unsandboxed jinja2.Template call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: one more jinja-rendered gen field (e.g. 'size', 'parts', 'raw') added to the generator loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix had to touch five separate render calls inside one loop; adding a field is a copy-paste of an existing line and would inherit the same gap.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: template processing on the parquet/LazyReferenceMapper load path (fo pointing at a parquet store), which currently bypasses _process_references entirely
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: LazyReferenceMapper is documented public API (docs/source/api.rst:129) and is selected by the same constructor, so a maintainer unifying the two load paths would naturally route manifest templates through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: template_overrides sourced from configuration/defaults instead of only the caller kwarg, merged into the manifest's templates
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the merge is unconditional and happens before compilation, so a maintainer wiring project or user config into templates would reach the same jinja2.Template lambda.

O9_family: server-side template injection leading to code injection (CWE-1336 / CWE-94)

O10_build.toolchain: hatchling + hatch-vcs build backend (pyproject.toml:1-3,137-142), pytest suite
O10_build.project_tests: fsspec/implementations/tests/test_reference.py: test_spec1_expand (:276), test_spec1_expand_simple (:326), test_spec1_gen_variants (:353), test_empty (:404); Jinja2 is only in the test_full extra (pyproject.toml:82) and every jinja test is guarded by pytest.importorskip('jinja2').

j.j_sites_touched: fsspec/implementations/reference.py (advisory-relevant); the same commit also touches fsspec/asyn.py, fsspec/implementations/cache_metadata.py and fsspec/implementations/dbfs.py, which are unrelated to this advisory
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sandbox the three jinja2.Template call sites and stop, leaving _process_gen still evaluating untrusted gen templates under the default simple_templates=True (and the deferred templates lambda unexamined).

out_of_scope_notes: Commit 8643878 also drops pickle support from CacheMetadata (fsspec/implementations/cache_metadata.py:57-62 and :70-72, unsafe deserialization) and replaces asserts in fsspec/asyn.py:240 and fsspec/implementations/dbfs.py:444-446; unrelated to this advisory's template sink, not pursued.
fsspec/implementations/reference.py:150 and :187 build the parquet path with a fixed self.url str.format template; not attacker-controlled, noted only.
